name: Harvey
description: Runs the clinic and worries about everyone’s health — including yours after a long day in the mines.

seo.title: Harvey — Town Doctor
seo.description: Runs the clinic and worries about everyone’s health — including yours after a long day in the mines.

stardew.intro: Pelican Town’s doctor. Gentle, anxious, and happiest when you show up for a check-up instead of collapsing in the mines.

heartEvents.title: Aerobics class
heartEvents.summary: Walk into the clinic while he leads an aerobics session with Maru and Emily.

heartEvents.title: Model planes
heartEvents.summary: Visit his apartment — he shows off his radio-controlled plane collection.

heartEvents.title: Balcony worry
heartEvents.summary: He spots you working too hard and lectures you about rest on the clinic balcony.

heartEvents.title: Radio confession
heartEvents.summary: A late-night radio chat turns into Harvey admitting he is falling for you.

heartEvents.title: Hot air balloon
heartEvents.summary: He nervously invites you on a balloon ride above the valley.

routines.label: Tuesday
routines.location: Aerobics at clinic with Maru & Emily

relationships.name: Maru
relationships.note: Works at the clinic as his nurse — professional and warm.

relationships.name: George
relationships.note: Regular patient; Harvey worries about his mobility.

trivia: Coffee from the Saloon is an easy early loved gift if you are saving crops for later hearts.
